1879072545.name: Death Blossom
1879072545.desc: You release several arrows in quick succession hitting multiple foes around your target.

1879073697.name: Strong Pull
1879073697.desc: You pull on your bow and loose an arrow.

1879097889.name: Command Post
1879097889.desc: You place a banner bearing the symbol of the mightiest Orc tribe, the Krahjarn. All who stand near the banner draw offensive strength from the symbol.

1879115297.name: Eldar's Kiss
1879115297.desc: You release several arrows in quick succession, hitting multiple foes around your target.

1879135905.name: Defiant Challenge
1879135905.desc: Forces up to 10 nearby enemies to attack the Warden.\n\nAllows the Warden to damage all attackers after each blow.

1879139745.name: Steel Grasping Web
1879139745.desc:
A web attack that roots several targets in place. <rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879149601.name: Venomous Haze
1879149601.desc: You can spit blinding poison into the eyes of your enemies, reducing the range of their skills. This skill is only effective against players.

1879157281.name: Herbalist
1879157281.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Herbalist.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879209889.name: Steed of the Champion
1879209889.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the champion.

1879210657.name: Poisonous Silk
1879210657.desc: The hatchling spits toxin infused threads of silk damaging and slowing its prey.  If the threads are not removed the prey becomes completely immobilized.

1879215265.name: Improved Burning Embers
1879215265.desc: Burn the enemy with damage-over-time, slowing movement.

conditionalEffects.description:
After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.

1879230497.name: Brutal Fangs
1879230497.desc: You rip at your target's flesh, tearing muscle and slowing his attacks. If the target was suffering from your crippling bite he begins taking damage over time.

1879241633.name: Ballad - Saga
1879241633.desc: Sagas tell tales of old that speak of the victory of light over darkness.

1879266849.name: For Annúminas!
1879266849.desc: Calenglad's battle-cry brings to mind the city of  Annúminas, and lowers the morale of his opponents.

1879272097.name: Devastating Strike
1879272097.desc: Single-target attack that briefly increases the amount of damage enemies take.

1879277985.name: Concession and Rebuttal: Writ of Lightning
1879277985.desc: Deals lightning damage and lowers target's Tactical Mitigation.\n\nThis effect stacks up to 3 times.

1879288481.name: Ambush with Flame
1879288481.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879305761.name: Orange Wyandotte Chicken
1879305761.desc: Summons an orange Wyandotte chicken to brighten your day.

1879354401.name: Sting
1879354401.desc: When Frodo fell to Shelob's venom, Samwise Gamgee took up Sting. The Orcs of Cirith Ungol shall soon know it well!

1879365409.name: Dale Calf
1879365409.desc: Brings out a Dale calf to keep you company.

1879406753.name: Black-foot Carrying Chicken
1879406753.desc: Carry around your prized Black-foot chicken.

1879411745.name: Alabaster Donkey
1879411745.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working donkey.

1879415713.name: Subtle Portent of Strength
1879415713.desc: A quick burst of strength, increasing the amount of damage you do.

1879457569.name: The Way of the Fist
1879457569.desc:
Wardens know that the surest path to victory is relying on the basics.

This skill changes to match the type of the last gambit used.

The Way of the Fist will consume all your Advanced Technique to briefly improve the potency of your damage over time effects.

1879459361.name: Test Melee Tactical
1879459361.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879466273.name: Sail to Snowbourn
1879466273.desc: Navigate to Snowbourn with nearby fellows.

1879467809.name: Nature's Salve
1879467809.desc: Restores Morale to allies in an area around your target.

1879488033.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Dune-stalker Caracal)
1879488033.desc: Summons a lynx-type companion.\n\nThe caracal is a stealthy hunter.

1879490721.name: Shadow Hedgehog
1879490721.desc: Summons a shadowy hedgehog to accompany you on your travels.

1879491489.name: Return to Iridír
1879491489.desc: You're able to quickly return to Iridír in Ambarûl in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879492385.name: Sophisticated Chaffinch
1879492385.desc: Summons a delightful songbird to accompany you on your adventures.

1879522081.name: Plant a Patch of: Poppies
1879522081.desc: Plant some seeds and make a lovely patch of poppies.

1879529121.name: Drop the Fragment of the Crown
1879529121.desc: Drop the Army of Angmar's artifact.

1879529505.name: Mottled Mirkwood Stag
1879529505.desc: Summons a mottled Mirkwood stag to accompany you on your travels.
